transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1874 Somersworth Drive?
Yeah, this is me at 1874 Somersworth Drive, just chillin’ here safe and dry, no water inside at all, and I’m all by myself but I’m totally fine—no need for a truck or boat or anything, I got this.
How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Just me here, all by myself, no one else around, and I’m totally fine—no water in the house either, so no rush.
Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
Nope, just me, all good, no one here who can’t leave on their own, not even a wheelchair or oxygen—everything’s fine, no water inside either.
Thanks for checking in, glad to hear everything’s fine. Is there water inside the home right now?
Nope, no water inside at all, just me here, all good, nothing to worry about.
Thanks for checking in, glad you’re okay. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Nope, I’m good, just me here, no water inside, and I don’t have a truck, boat, or any free seats to spare—sorry!
Let me read that back: people at the home not confirmed; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—just me here, no water in yet, and I’m totally fine, no need for help or anything.
Thanks for confirming you’re okay and safe right now. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
